sequence._note: travel and hold are timeline units, not seconds: they set the SHAPE of a transition (how much of it the part spends flying versus held under the spotlight). scroll.springHz sets the SPEED. speed/autoOrbit/inspectSpin are read by the studio's autoplay; the hero drives position from the scroll spring instead and ignores speed.

_materialNote: match is a regex tried against the normalised occurrence name. Order matters; the last entry should be a catch-all. Board substrate is matched by suffix before any of these.
_boardNote: Each entry merges into one group at load: substrate fragments named <prefix>_pad/_silkscreen/_soldermask/_PCB, plus every occurrence standing on the board. 'exclude' keeps things that merely pass through the board plane (standoffs, stack screws) out of it.
_beatNote: select is one of: {board}, {names}, {cluster} one spatial cluster, {complement} everything not in another beat. choreo names a built-in behaviour. caption is the beginner explainer under the note, hint is a one-line 'connects to', href links the beat to its product page; a stop that is active shows its own caption/hint/href, not the beat's. Copy baseline: drafts/beginner-narrative.md.

_status: WIRED BOTH WAYS. app/components/HeroDroneScene.tsx reads this file at runtime. public/models/od3/_studio.html loads it on open, including the beat timeline, so every control starts on the value the site renders, and its save button POSTs the whole file back through the dev-only /__studio/write endpoint. The panel edits beat titles, notes, captions, hints, hrefs, fade, partSize and stops (each stop with its own caption, hint and href, which replace the beat-level ones while the stop is active), but not the shape of the timeline: adding, deleting and reordering beats, and every `select` and `choreo`, are file edits. Also carried through untouched on save: name, model, boards, boardExclude, videoModule, notFrame, scroll.minDwellS, spotlight.beamGain (which the panel renderer has no equivalent for), and each material id, label and match.
